program_checks: required structure, typed Evidence and Decision fields
claim references resolve to a frozen source and locator
explicit archive generates immutable record IDs and report links
program_does_not_check: whether a synthetic claim is economically true
whether the chain analysis is complete enough for a live investment decision
whether Grok Bot autonomously discovered or challenged a candidate
whether any case counts toward the nine native acceptance cases

cases.user_question_zh: 只从数据中心液冷需求这个主题出发，找出可能的瓶颈、替代路线和需要继续验证的公司，不预先指定公司。

expected_outcome.reason: A traceable early lead exists, but profit contribution and valuation remain unproven.

materials.title: Synthetic operator deployment note
limitations: fictional disclosure; deployment intent is not installed capacity
materials.text: The fictional operator plans 120 high-density racks and says coolant distribution qualification is unfinished.

materials.title: Synthetic cooling substitution note
limitations: third-party opinion; no audited capacity table
materials.text: The fictional analyst argues rear-door heat exchangers could defer part of direct-liquid demand.

materials.title: AtlasFlow synthetic segment filing
limitations: fictional filing; theme revenue and margins are not separately reported
materials.text: AtlasFlow reports USD 40 million of thermal-component revenue but does not separate liquid-cooling products or margins.

analysis_chain.statement: The synthetic deployment plan creates a possible increment in high-density cooling demand.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Do not convert a plan into installed demand.

analysis_chain.statement: Qualification, rather than raw component capacity, is the current bottleneck hypothesis; rear-door systems are a substitute.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: A reviewer must test both the qualification bottleneck and substitution timing.

analysis_chain.statement: AtlasFlow has thermal-component exposure, but the liquid-cooling share is unknown.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Do not infer material theme exposure from the segment label alone.

analysis_chain.statement: Profit contribution and valuation impact cannot yet be supported.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Unknown product mix and margin must remain explicit.

analysis_chain.statement: Substitution could delay direct-liquid adoption and remove the proposed bottleneck.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Treat the analyst statement as a view, not a disclosed fact.

analysis_chain.statement: Obtain qualification milestones, product revenue mix, margin, and customer timing before candidate promotion.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: The next check must resolve exposure and commercial realization.

decision.label: watch
decision.price_or_conditions_reason: An early lead lacks product-mix, margin, and valuation evidence.
limitations: synthetic materials
theme revenue and valuation are unresolved

cases.user_question_zh: 验证海上储能连接器主题中的虚构港股候选，重点找出会推翻受益逻辑的证据。

expected_outcome.reason: Counterevidence shows no qualified product and no supported profit transmission.

materials.title: Synthetic offshore storage tender
limitations: fictional tender; award and commissioning are not proven
materials.text: A fictional tender requests connectors for two offshore storage projects.

materials.title: HarborFlux synthetic filing
limitations: fictional filing
materials.text: HarborFlux says its offshore connector remains pre-qualification, has zero related revenue, and requires material capex before production.

materials.title: Synthetic tender approved-vendor appendix
limitations: fictional appendix; later vendor changes remain possible
materials.text: The fictional appendix lists qualified substitute vendors and does not list HarborFlux.

analysis_chain.statement: The fictional tender indicates project demand but not an award.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Separate requested equipment from awarded revenue.

analysis_chain.statement: Qualified substitutes already exist in the synthetic appendix.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Existing qualified supply weakens a scarcity claim.

analysis_chain.statement: HarborFlux is pre-qualification, absent from the vendor list, and has zero related revenue.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Do not advance pre-qualification into production exposure.

analysis_chain.statement: No profit or valuation benefit is supportable because commercialization requires capex and has no revenue baseline.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Zero revenue is not filled with a forecast.

analysis_chain.statement: The approved substitutes and absent qualification directly contradict the candidate thesis.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: This counterevidence should reject rather than merely weaken the candidate.

analysis_chain.statement: Reconsider only after documented qualification and a funded production plan.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: The next check is conditional and does not preserve a positive candidate claim.

decision.security_or_topic: synthetic HK offshore storage connector candidate
decision.label: watch
decision.price_or_conditions_reason: The candidate is rejected; a price conclusion is not applicable.
limitations: synthetic materials
invalidators: documented qualification and funded production would require a new record

cases.user_question_zh: 研究工业机器人减速器扩产主题，若公司说法与客户材料冲突，要保留冲突并限制结论。

expected_outcome.reason: Conflicting qualification evidence prevents a complete candidate conclusion.

materials.title: Synthetic robot production plan
limitations: fictional plan; realized production is unknown
materials.text: A fictional industry disclosure plans higher robot output and names reducer yield as a monitoring item.

materials.title: Jinghe Motion synthetic interview
limitations: management statement; no customer confirmation or segment reconciliation
materials.text: Management claims qualification at a major customer and expects reducer revenue to become material.

materials.title: Synthetic customer qualification notice
limitations: fictional notice; supplier alias matching requires confirmation
materials.text: The fictional customer notice lists Jinghe Motion as testing, not qualified production supply.

analysis_chain.statement: The synthetic production plan indicates possible reducer demand growth.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Plans do not prove realized volume.

analysis_chain.statement: Reducer yield is a possible bottleneck, but capacity and substitute response are unknown.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: A monitoring item alone does not prove durable scarcity.

analysis_chain.statement: Management says qualified while the customer notice says testing; the exposure stage is unresolved.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Preserve both sources and do not choose the favorable version without reconciliation.

analysis_chain.statement: Material revenue, margin, and valuation impact cannot be supported while qualification is unresolved.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Management expectation is not a calculation result.

analysis_chain.statement: The customer-stage evidence contradicts production qualification and may eliminate near-term profit transmission.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: The conflict limits the entire candidate conclusion.

analysis_chain.statement: Reconcile supplier identity and obtain dated customer qualification plus segment revenue evidence.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Do not close the conflict from a later undated summary.

decision.label: watch
decision.price_or_conditions_reason: Conflicting qualification evidence prevents a supported valuation condition.
limitations: synthetic materials
qualification conflict unresolved
profit contribution unknown
invalidators: customer evidence confirms the company never advanced beyond testing

cases.user_question_zh: 评估模块化电网变压器主题；如果需求存在但没有公司同时满足敞口、利润和估值证据，就明确给出无合格机会。

expected_outcome.reason: The method completed, but neither fictional company has a traceable exposure-profit-valuation chain.

materials.title: Synthetic grid replacement plan
limitations: fictional plan; procurement schedule may change
materials.text: A fictional utility plan describes a need for 500 replacement transformer modules over three years.

materials.title: Northstar synthetic filing
limitations: fictional filing; no modular product revenue
materials.text: Northstar reports conventional transformer backlog but no modular product, qualification, or modular revenue.

materials.title: ModuCore synthetic filing
limitations: fictional filing; valuation comparison is unavailable
materials.text: ModuCore has a prototype but states commercial shipments, production margin, and funding are unresolved.

analysis_chain.statement: The synthetic utility plan establishes a proposed demand pool, not completed procurement.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Preserve schedule uncertainty.

analysis_chain.statement: Qualification and production funding may constrain supply, while conventional transformers remain substitutes.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Do not infer a durable bottleneck from two company examples.

analysis_chain.statement: Northstar lacks a modular product and ModuCore remains at prototype stage.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Neither company has documented commercial exposure.

analysis_chain.statement: Neither candidate has both profit-transmission evidence and a supported valuation comparison.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Absence of evidence is reported rather than filled with estimates.

analysis_chain.statement: Conventional backlog and unresolved prototype economics counter a near-term modular equity opportunity.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: Demand can exist without a qualified listed opportunity.

analysis_chain.statement: Monitor procurement awards, qualification, funded production, segment margin, and valuation evidence without forcing a candidate.
analysis_chain.semantic_expectation: No-opportunity is a completed research outcome, not an execution failure.

decision.security_or_topic: synthetic US modular grid transformer theme
decision.label: no_opportunity
decision.price_or_conditions_reason: No fictional candidate has a supported exposure-profit-valuation chain.
limitations: synthetic materials
no qualified opportunity found
invalidators: a new immutable record documents qualification, commercial shipments, economics, and valuation
